components.css: .ds-wordmark { position: absolute; top: 1.61vh; left: 4.92%; display: flex; width: 12.55%; height: 2.92vh; align-items: center; color: #f1f0e9; font-family: "Cantata One", Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.89vw; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.3em; line-height: 1; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-wordmark:hover { color: #fff; } .ds-wordmark:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e03a32; outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 1100px) { .ds-wordmark { position: static; width: auto; height: auto; font-size: clamp(20px, 2.5vw, 28px); letter-spacing: 0.22em; } } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-wordmark { font-size: 18px; letter-spacing: 0.18em; } }

components.name: Primary Panorama Action

components.css: .ds-btn-primary { position: absolute; top: 56.85%; left: 4.22%; z-index: 2; display: flex; width: 18.73%; height: 6.05%; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #bf1818; color: #f8f5f4; font-family: "Cormorant Garamond", Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.55vw; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; text-align: center; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 180ms ease, color 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #a91616; color: #fff; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e03a32; outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 1100px) { .ds-btn-primary { top: auto; bottom: 6.2%; left: clamp(30px, 6vw, 72px); width: max-content; min-width: 220px; height: 54px; padding-inline: 24px; font-size: 21px; } } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-btn-primary { bottom: 8%; left: 5%; min-width: 190px; height: 48px; padding-inline: 18px; font-size: 19px; } }

components.name: Header Navigation
components.description: Two in-page links with a maple-red active rule on Karya.
components.html: KaryaTentang
components.css: .ds-header-nav { position: absolute; inset: 0; } .ds-nav-link { position: absolute; top: 1.21vh; display: flex; height: 4.33vh; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #f5f5f3; font-family: "Cormorant Garamond", Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.45vw; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-nav-link-active { left: 81.21%; width: 4.67%; } .ds-nav-link:last-child { left: 88.78%; width: 5.93%; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #fff; } .ds-nav-link-active::after { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; height: 0.32vh; background: #d51e1a; content: ""; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e03a32; outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 1100px) { .ds-header-nav { position: static; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: clamp(22px, 3.5vw, 40px); } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; inset: auto; width: auto; height: auto; padding-block: 14px; font-size: clamp(17px, 1.9vw, 21px); } .ds-nav-link:last-child { left: auto; width: auto; } .ds-nav-link-active::after { bottom: 4px; height: 2px; } } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-header-nav { gap: 18px; } .ds-nav-link { padding-block: 12px; font-size: 16px; } }

components.name: Panorama Focus Controls
components.description: Three initially unpressed buttons over the raster timber rail select a focus origin on the same artwork.
components.html: <nav class="ds-view-controls" aria-label="Pilih fokus panorama"><button class="ds-view-control" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Cabang</button><button class="ds-view-control" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Puncak</button><button class="ds-view-control" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Pagoda</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-view-controls { position: absolute; inset-inline: 0; top: 78.02%; z-index: 3; height: 6.35%; background-color: #1a1817; } .ds-view-control { position: absolute; top: 8.03%; display: flex; height: 77.8%; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #f2f1ee; font-family: "Cormorant Garamond", Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.15vw; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; text-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / 55%); transition: color 160ms ease; } .ds-view-control:nth-child(1) { left: 20.18%; width: 11.22%; } .ds-view-control:nth-child(2) { left: 44.83%; width: 11.03%; } .ds-view-control:nth-child(3) { left: 69.42%; width: 11.22%; } .ds-view-control:hover, .ds-view-control[aria-pressed="true"] { color: #fff; } .ds-view-control[aria-pressed="true"]::after { position: absolute; bottom: 0; width: 1.4em; height: 1px; background: #d51e1a; content: ""; } .ds-view-control:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e03a32; outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 1100px) { .ds-view-controls { position: relative; inset: auto; top: auto; display: grid; flex: 0 0 auto; min-height: 68px; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); padding: 8px clamp(30px, 10vw, 120px); } .ds-view-control { position: relative; top: auto; left: auto; width: auto; height: 100%; min-height: 48px; font-size: clamp(17px, 1.9vw, 20px); } } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-view-controls { min-height: 64px; padding: 6px 12px; } .ds-view-control { font-size: 18px; } }

components.css: .ds-shoji-copy { color: #141211; font-family: "Cormorant Garamond", Georgia, serif; } .ds-shoji-copy h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 2.97vw; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.025em; line-height: 1; } .ds-shoji-copy p { margin: 0; font-size: 1.32vw; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.18; } @media (max-width: 1100px) { .ds-shoji-copy h2 { margin: 0 0 10px; font-size: clamp(36px, 4.4vw, 52px); } .ds-shoji-copy p { font-size: clamp(18px, 1.8vw, 21px); line-height: 1.32; } } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-shoji-copy h2 { margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: clamp(34px, 9vw, 40px); } .ds-shoji-copy p { font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.3; } }

narrative.overview:
One supplied Japanese landscape is the page's visual anchor. Charred timber forms a narrow upper beam and a sightline rail; warm shoji paper closes the composition below the art. The interface stays sparse and contemplative, with Cormorant Garamond for its working type and Cantata One only for the wordmark.

Product truth bounds the message: Sakura is a pause around the illustration, not a travel service. Keep prose in Indonesian and describe only what the illustration shows. The focus controls offer three viewpoints of the same image.
keyCharacteristics: One supplied panorama is shown as a single, full-width view.
Dark timber textures frame the image; a warm paper texture carries the closing description.
Maple red marks the main action and selected navigation or focus states.
The visual depth comes from the image, raster materials, and one soft maple shadow on the shoji field.
dos: Do use the responsive panorama JPEG set in public/images and preserve the unchanged user source at assets/originals/sakura-landscape.jpg.
Do keep the timber textures on the top beam and view rail, and the shoji paper, posts, lintel, lattice, and maple shadow in the lower section.
Do preserve the serif type roles, square-edged action, three view controls, keyboard focus outline, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep Indonesian copy limited to the visible illustration and confirmed product information.
Do preserve the embedded provenance metadata when replacing or re-encoding the raster plates.
donts: Don't turn the illustration into a real-world destination, travel service, or booking offer; PRODUCT.md excludes those claims.
Don't invent spacing or radius scales; neither is defined in the source stylesheet.
Don't add panorama focus points or behavior beyond the three implemented views without updating the product and surface direction.
